reason: PRISM estimates quality/risk drift in quantized, LoRA-adapted, and distilled LLM variants from a forward pass, including GPTQ evaluations. It is a model-variant audit/selection method rather than an inference-efficiency improvement; its quantization-family relation makes it a plausible but secondary systems-quality connection.
title: PRISM: A Geometric Risk Bound for Decomposing Drift into Scale, Shape, and Head
